text: On this digits fixture, AdamW weight decay 0.01 vs 0 produced no measurable change in test accuracy: the paired-bootstrap interval for the primary effect is degenerate at zero and predictions are identical in all three seeds. h1 (positive effect) is not supported; it is not falsified, and equivalence is not established.
limitations: The bootstrap conditions on the trained models and does not estimate training-population variance. The finite test set limits inference about unseen examples. Prior Haiku/Luna results are known, so this is not confirmation or an equivalence test.

text: Parameters and training losses differ between decay arms while predictions agree. This is consistent with different training trajectories; the comparison alone does not prove correct implementation of the decay update or rule out every bug.
limitations: Post-hoc audit. Weight differences cannot separate the decay effect from run-to-run divergence; no much-larger-decay ablation was run.

text: A possible explanation for unchanged accuracy is the small per-step decay coefficient at the registered learning rate and weight decay. This is an untested hypothesis: gradient trajectories and decision margins also matter, so the coefficient alone does not establish the size of the fitted model change.
limitations: Hypothesis from arithmetic on the documented update rule, not an intervention; the sensitivity arm (weaker decay) does not test larger decay.

text: The weaker-decay sensitivity arm also matched the unregularized arm in observed accuracy. This statement concerns accuracy at the tested settings, not all model outputs or a population dose-response.
limitations: Only one weaker dose; descriptive role only.

text: Controls behaved as expected: shuffled-label training scored near chance, the class-prior baseline near chance, and logistic regression slightly below the MLPs, so the pipeline measures real signal.
limitations: Logistic baseline has one seed and untuned hyperparameters; its gap to the MLP is small and uncertainty was not quantified.

text: This run was executed with prior Haiku/Luna results known, so it provides exploratory replication only, not independent confirmation.
limitations: Prior runs were summarized from their READMEs, not re-derived.
